serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I should just let it go. 
No real harm was caused by her, only my pride was wounded.
I should man up and stop minding the small things, especially when my retaliation could cause some harm to someone I care about… 
There’s also some truth to what {f_botName} said. Since I found her I haven't used my ‘collection’ at all. There’s no longer a point in keeping it on my hard drive.
Let’s just forget about that matter and keep on living.
